crime: A caregiver once left {WITCH_NAME} to run a minor errand on a calm afternoon and died before reaching the destination. In prison, {WITCH_NAME}'s cellmate asked her to come along through an empty second-floor corridor. The walk became a daily routine, and {WITCH_NAME} always followed close behind.

One day, the cellmate decided to try the route alone. She returned with a torn sleeve and bruises around both wrists. Someone had shoved her toward the railing, and she had escaped a fall only by grabbing it.

Before the cells were locked that night, another girl privately admitted the shove to {WITCH_NAME}. The girl said she had wanted to prove that the cellmate could not be kept safe at every moment that went unwitnessed. Next time, there would be nothing within reach for the cellmate to grab.
{WITCH_NAME} refused to wait for that next attack. At supper, a ceramic cup broke at her table, and she hid one sharp shard.

At ten o'clock, a girl in the opposite cell saw the attacker alone in a single cell as its barred door was locked from outside. {WITCH_NAME}'s power allowed only one chosen person at a time. Once the corridor was empty, she chose the attacker. Distance and closed doors did not stop the teleport, and the shard she carried went with her when she appeared behind the attacker inside the locked cell. {WITCH_NAME} cut the attacker's throat, but the dying girl grabbed the distinctive cuff on her killer's uniform and tore away several threads. For the next teleport, {WITCH_NAME} replaced the attacker with her sleeping cellmate and returned behind the cellmate inside their own locked cell.

The body was found in the still-locked single cell at the morning unlock. Threads under the dead girl's nails matched the frayed edge of a fresh tear in the killer's assigned cuff. The threads proved that the cuff's wearer had struggled with the dead girl, while the witness's account and the fact that both doors remained locked left Step Behind as the only way {WITCH_NAME} could have entered and returned.
fields.epitaph: She stayed one step behind the same shoulder; danger did not need to come from ahead.
execution: A giant iron figure stands with its back to her, and a fixed iron plate rises behind her. She is clamped upright in the one-step gap between them.
The figure begins walking backward. Its broad back presses into her chest and drives her against the plate. The figure is not a person, so she cannot name it and escape behind it.
It keeps stepping back until her chest and spine are crushed between the two iron surfaces. She dies there.

magic.name: Step Behind
magic.text: She can teleport one step behind a person she chooses.
